firstRun.title: Set up Edikte
firstRun.welcome: Edikte lists real estate from court auctions at edikte.justiz.gv.at and insolvency sales at JustizOnline. It can analyze appraisal reports (Gutachten) with an AI provider you sign in to. Choose a few settings to start; you can change all of them later in Settings.
firstRun.saveFailed: The setup could not be saved.

language.title: Language
language.text: Choose the language of the app.

providers.title: AI providers
providers.text: Edikte checks which AI providers are ready to use on this computer. Analysis is optional, and you can set up providers later in Settings.
providers.detectFailed: The check for AI providers did not finish.

sync.title: First sync
sync.text: Choose the sources and Bundesländer whose listings the app loads. You can change this later in Settings.
